name: Cost and Rate-Limit Model
description: Model costs per token (input/output) and rate limits per provider/model tier. Expose cost and rate-limit data to the scheduler for budgeting decisions — enable cost-aware routing, spend caps, and rate-limit-aware request batching. Track running costs per session and per billing period.
purpose: Enable cost-conscious and rate-limit-aware provider selection by modeling per-token pricing and throughput constraints, then exposing those to the routing and scheduling layers.
acceptanceCriteria: Cost model maps model+provider to inputTokenCost and outputTokenCost (per 1K tokens)
Rate-limit model captures: requestsPerMinute, tokensPerMinute, concurrentRequests
Costs for popular models pre-populated from published pricing
Running cost tracker accumulates session spend with configurable budget cap
Rate-limit state is observable: remaining quota, reset time, current concurrency
Cost-aware routing score function exposed for scheduler integration
Pricing data refresh mechanism for when providers change rates
